keyword: what channel is the world baseball classic on

verifications.claim: The 2026 World Baseball Classic is broadcast exclusively in the United States on the FOX Sports family of networks.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'FOX’s family of sports networks. Those channels are FOX, FS1, FS2, FOX Deportes (Spanish), TUBI, Fox Sports App'; R3: 'FOX is your exclusive home to the WBC with games spread across the FOX family of networks.'
verifications.reasoning: R3 directly states FOX is the exclusive home in US context; R1 lists the family of networks.

verifications.claim: The 2026 World Baseball Classic is broadcast primarily on FS1 and FOX.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R1: 'FOX, FS1, FS2, FOX Deportes...'; examples semis on FS1, final on FOX; R3: semis on FS1, final on FOX.
verifications.reasoning: References mention FOX and FS1 prominently for key games, but also list other networks like FS2, FOX Deportes, TUBI; 'primarily' is supported but not precisely stated.

verifications.claim: Games of the 2026 World Baseball Classic are available via streaming on the FOX One app.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'All games will be available for streaming on the FOX Sports app and FOX One.'; R6: 'Streaming: FOX One App'
verifications.reasoning: Direct statements confirm streaming availability on FOX One app.

verifications.claim: Semifinals and quarterfinals of the 2026 World Baseball Classic are March 15-17.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R1: semis March 15 & 16; R2: quarters March 13-14, semis 15-16; R3: semis March 15 & 16.
verifications.reasoning: Quarterfinals are March 13-14, not 15-17; semis are 15-16, so claim incorrectly includes quarters in 15-17 range.

verifications.claim: Semifinals and quarterfinals of the 2026 World Baseball Classic are mostly on FS1.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R1: March 15 semifinal FS1, March 16 FS1; R3: semis on FS1.
verifications.reasoning: Semis clearly on FS1, but no channel info for quarterfinals; 'mostly' partially supported but incomplete.

verifications.claim: The championship game of the 2026 World Baseball Classic is scheduled for Tuesday, March 17 at 8 PM ET on FOX.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'finals ... Tuesday, March 17, at 8 PM ET on FOX.'; R3: 'Championship Game ... Tuesday, March 17 (8 p.m. ET) [on FOX]'.
verifications.reasoning: Exact match on date, day, time, and channel.

verifications.claim: FOX Deportes offers Spanish-language coverage of the 2026 World Baseball Classic.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.reasoning: Directly lists FOX Deportes as Spanish coverage in family of networks for WBC.

verifications.claim: The FOX One app is a streaming option to watch the 2026 World Baseball Classic live.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'available for streaming on ... FOX One.'; R6: 'Streaming: FOX One App'
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly stated as streaming option for WBC games.

verifications.claim: FOXSports.com is a streaming option to watch the 2026 World Baseball Classic live.
verifications.label: OMITTED
